name: subordination
quote: I need to check with the boss.
description: The sense that specific actions or decisions are induced by others, but that you have chosen to make the commitment to follow the direction.

variations.name: responsibility
variations.description: It's your duty to perform tasks expected of you, even if you wouldn't choose to do them without the group's request, but at least you have chosen to belong to the group.
examples: Most families and jobs require individuals to accept tasks they might not choose to do themselves.

variations.name: existential subordination
variations.description: Sense of commitment to aligning your decisions to a deeper purpose or ideal.

commentaries.quote: Groups can work better if some individuals temporarily suppress their own agency so as to coordinate with others.
Even though parents might make decisions for the children, the adults have a responsibility to set aside their own preferences to deal with family needs as necessary.

conditions: The sense that specific actions or decisions are induced by others, but that you have chosen to make the commitment to follow the direction.
